input: Draft a five-year career progression roadmap

gold.taskTitle: Draft a five-year career progression roadmap
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured, personalised five-year plan that maps out the steps, milestones, and actions needed to advance the user's career.

questions.title: What is your current job title and industry?
questions.description: Understand the user's starting point so the roadmap is grounded in their present role and field.

questions.title: What specific role or position do you want in five years?
questions.description: Identify the exact target destination the roadmap needs to lead toward.

questions.title: What is your biggest professional gap right now?
questions.description: Pinpoint the most critical skill, credential, or experience the user currently lacks.

questions.title: Are you open to changing companies to advance your career?
questions.description: Determine whether the roadmap should be built around internal promotion or external moves.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you invest in development?
questions.description: Establish the realistic time commitment available for learning, networking, or side projects.

questions.title: Do you have a budget for courses, certifications, or coaching?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints so recommendations stay practical and achievable.

questions.title: Is location flexibility a factor in your career progression?
questions.description: Find out whether relocation or remote work is on the table, as this affects opportunity planning.
